hazards.unsafeCondition: A clinically required action is omitted from a proposed or final plan.

mitigations.description: Fresh deterministic safety recomputation blocks finalization.

hazards.unsafeCondition: A contraindicated or otherwise unsafe action is commissioned.

mitigations.description: Safety and DDI findings fail closed and are bound to the reviewed plan.

hazards.unsafeCondition: Missing or unresolved source data is hidden from the reviewing clinician.

mitigations.description: Eligibility and synthesis preserve unresolved-data explanations.

hazards.unsafeCondition: An override is unattributed, unauthorized, or applied to a non-overridable blocker.

mitigations.description: Override workflows require an authenticated actor, rationale, and immutable provenance.

hazards.unsafeCondition: Excessive or poorly prioritized alerts cause alert fatigue or use error.

mitigations.description: Clinical validation measures alert burden and human-factors outcomes against an approved protocol.

hazards.unsafeCondition: A failed migration or container recovery exposes a partially available clinical workflow.

mitigations.description: Deployment verification gates readiness on migrations and restart recovery.
